caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

rows.name: Systems go-live (PMS / POS / PABX / network / BMS)
rows.notes: Server room handover is the real predecessor. Compressing go-live to T-1 without a handed-over room is high risk.

rows.name: OS&E order
rows.failure_example: Clock delivered; no socket at the install point — delivered but unusable.

rows.name: Mass recruitment and key hires (split — structural gap #1)
rows.fallback_note: A borrowed task force is not a substitute for an in-post department head; inheritance and snag ownership stay weak.

rows.name: Licence submission
rows.notes: Fire/CD paces the occupancy / completion certificate. Start collecting prerequisite IDs at least T-2. Do not treat submission as a calendar constant.
